randomness.scheme: Deterministic SHA-256 counter stream. Each role's SecureRandom returns the concatenation of SHA-256(seedAscii || be32(i)) for i = 0, 1, 2, ..., consumed sequentially across calls; seedAscii is "SPK-2/EC-JPAKE/client/v1" for the client and "SPK-2/EC-JPAKE/server/v1" for the server. A port does not need to reimplement this: 'log' below lists, in call order, every byte string SecureRandom.nextBytes returned to EcJpake.
